problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

The vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}$ are eigenvectors that correspond to the eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=3$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=2$ of the matrix $A,$ given above. Find the third eigenvector ${v}_{3}=[a,\,b,\,c]^{T}$ such that the set ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}}$ is linearly independent. What is the value of $\frac{b}{c}?$

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating the Eigenvectors of a 3x3 Matrix With Distinct Eigenvalues
